verdicts.title: Complexity of Propositional Abduction for Restricted Sets of Boolean Functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Abduction is a fundamental and important form of non-monotonic reasoning. Given a knowledge base explaining how the world behaves it aims at finding an explanation for some observed manifestation.
